title: Niche snail-mail subscription club (under-1oz envelopes)
one_liner: Launch a niche physical mail club (art, recipes, stickers, handwritten/themed) kept under one ounce for cheap postage — tangible anti-digital product with low startup cost.
why_agent_runnable: Niche research, brand/copy, content calendars, subscriber CRM drafts, and ops checklists are agent-native. Brandon gates payments, physical assembly/postage, publish, and send.

ops_steps.title: Niche shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Score niches craving tangible mail (art, recipes, stickers, letters); check community density and postage fit under 1oz.

ops_steps.title: Brandon niche + brand pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose niche, brand name, and max startup spend for supplies/postage test.

ops_steps.title: Offer + weight engineering
ops_steps.detail: Design monthly SKU under 1oz; draft packing SOP and COGS sheet including postage.

ops_steps.title: Storefront + waitlist drafts
ops_steps.detail: Landing, waitlist, sample photos briefs, organic content plan — no paid ads required to start.

ops_steps.title: Publish + payments gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve domain/store, Stripe, first supply buy, and public launch.

ops_steps.title: Month-1 fulfill loop
ops_steps.detail: Print/assembly checklist for Brandon (or hired help after hire gate); agent logs subscribers and drafts customer replies.

ops_steps.title: Retention review
ops_steps.detail: Track churn, postage cost, time-per-piece; scale niche or kill if unit econ fails.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.startup_framing: near-zero to low hundreds for first test batch (supplies + postage)
unit_economics_sketch.postage_constraint: keep each piece under 1oz for cheap envelope rates
unit_economics_sketch.guest_anecdote_note: Guest story cited ~4.1k members / ~$50k/mo — public anecdote only, not a Brandon target
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Labor + postage dominate; organic growth assumed initially. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: niche shortlist with community evidence
Day 7: Brandon publish/payments gate for soft launch
kill_criteria: Cannot keep monthly piece under 1oz without killing perceived value
Waitlist <50 after 30 days organic with Brandon-approved posts
Time-per-piece makes fulfillment unsustainable at test volume
Brandon declines supply/postage spend or physical fulfill
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
